disposition_reason: One third-party laboratory report for a pea protein batch (Pb, As, Hg, Cd), submitted by the manufacturer to FDA with a GRAS notice.

study.design: manufacturer-commissioned laboratory report submitted to FDA with a GRAS notice
study.market: manufacturer production batch; not sampled from retail
lod: Method detection limits: Pb 0.05, As 0.01, Hg 0.01, Cd 0.005 mg/kg
study.qa: Accredited laboratory report; no QA data printed

material.label_as_printed: Pea protein concentrate (80% protein grade), manufacturer test

findings.group: Batch 1, third-party laboratory report submitted by the manufacturer (GRN 788)
findings.locator: Appendix II test report, PDF p. 49
findings.notes: Third-party test report dated Oct 24 2017; GB 5009.12-2017 (Pb), GB 5009.11-2014 (As), GB 5009.17-2014 (Hg), GB 5009.15-2014 (Cd); "Not detected" at the printed method detection limit. Cd method detection limit 0.005 mg/kg.
